scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix photos/web && node scripts/prepare-env.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-dev-ports.js && concurrently -n api,photos -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:photos:api" "npm run dev:photos:web"
scripts.dev:photos:api: node scripts/ensure-api.js && docker compose --env-file project.env up -d api
